ratification_gates._doc: Per CLAUDE.md OP-16 + the task's explicit spec. ALL FIVE required for an auto-ship DISABLE verdict on a currently-armed gate. evidence_n is advisory (a thin-n PASS is reported honestly, not silently upgraded).
ratification_gates.1_oos_positive: Recovered cohort's SS-B-replayed total pnl > 0 (this IS the 'value unblocking would have unlocked' since every testable gate in this battery is currently ARMED and every mined cohort is its own blocked-signal population).
ratification_gates.2_wf_ge_070: WF_per_trade = (oos_delta/n_oos) / (is_delta/n_is) >= 0.70, per backtest/safe_fill_bar_gate.py's canonical formula (G3). oos_delta/is_delta here = the recovered cohort's total pnl (the whole point of unblocking IS the delta, since these trades currently return exactly $0 by being skipped). n_is/is_delta per gate from prior_is_baseline above. WF is WAIVED-AS-N/A (not a silent fail) only where is_delta=0 with no IS trades in the population (block_elite_bull/bold, precedented by block_elite_bull_vix_high_18.json).
ratification_gates.3_sub_window_stable: <=1 of {sw1, sw2} negative, per windows.sub_windows above.
ratification_gates.4_anchor_no_regression: Per anchor_mechanism_precheck above -- PASS (reused or freshly verified) required; UNVERIFIED counts as NOT a clean pass (conservative treatment, OP-33 'verify don't claim').
ratification_gates.5_evidence_n_advisory: n (deduped events, post all exclusions) >= 15 is ADVISORY per OP-16 -- a thin-n PASS still ships if the other 4 gates clear, but is labeled thin in the scorecard, not hidden.
ratification_gates.bh_fdr_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg step-up across the set of gates that produce a real test statistic this run (up to 6), alpha=0.10, one-sided normal-approximation p-value for mean(trade_pnl) > 0 -- same algorithm as backtest/autoresearch/discovery_shadow_ledger.py#fdr_screen (sort by p ascending; largest i with p_i <= alpha*i/m is the significance cutoff; all i below it significant), reimplemented in the battery script rather than imported (that module's fdr_screen is coupled to its own ledger file format). A gate failing the BH-FDR cut does NOT auto-ship a DISABLE even if conditions 1-5 nominally clear (multiple-comparisons discipline, explicitly named in the task instructions).

decision_rule.statement: Gate ON-vs-OFF A/B per gate, all else held at current live config (per current_config.all_other_gates_held_at_current_live_config). Every gate in testable_this_session is CURRENTLY ARMED (True/non-zero) -- so 'OFF' is the recovered/replayed cohort (what would have happened had the gate not fired) and 'ON' is the status quo (those specific trades return $0, they were skipped). A clean PASS on all 5 ratification_gates + BH-FDR survival => DISABLE (flip the params key off), ship with a guard test + revert line, report for REVOKE (OP-0/OP-11 standing autonomy -- paper only, no J-gate needed).
